posts.title: Best Kurta Sets Under ₹600 on Meesho (Wash-Tested)
posts.body:
## How we picked

We ordered the five most-sold kurta sets under ₹600, washed each three times, and checked stitching, colour fastness and fit against the size charts.

## Top pick: Cotton printed set with palazzo

The only true cotton set in the batch. Colours held, threads stayed in place, and the palazzo has real pockets. Our tester is 5'4" and the M fit exactly as charted.

## Runner-up: Floor-length anarkali

Great drape for the price, but size **up** — the rayon runs one size small through the shoulders.

## What to avoid at this price

Sets that photograph like cotton but arrive as 100% polyester "rayon blend". Check the fabric field in the listing, not just the photos.

posts.title: Budget Calling Smartwatch: 2 Weeks With the ₹1,299 'Fit Pro'
pros: Real Bluetooth calling with decent mic
posts.body:
## Why we tested this

Budget calling watches all promise the same thing. We bought this one at its Meesho price and lived with it for two weeks — office days, workouts, and a full day of calls.

## Calling: the headline feature, and it works

Dialing from the wrist takes a couple of taps, and the mic picks up voice clearly indoors. On a busy road, callers said we sounded "a bit distant" but understandable. Speaker volume is fine for quiet rooms, not for traffic.

## Battery

With continuous heart-rate and two calls a day, we got **4 days** consistently. Without calling, stretch that to 6–7. The magnetic charger tops it up in about 90 minutes.

## The strap quirk

The quick-release pins are extremely tight out of the box. Warm the strap slightly with your fingers before your first swap — you'll avoid scratching the lugs.

## Should you buy?

Under ₹1,500, this is the best calling watch we've tested this quarter. If you only need fitness tracking, the cheaper bands still win on accuracy.

posts.title: Deal Alert: Airtight Storage Sets Dropped to ₹649
posts.body:
## The deal

The 6-piece clip-lock set we rated best-in-test is back near its lowest price on Meesho (₹649). Amazon has it at ₹749 — both links are on the product page.

## Why this set won

In our test, five "airtight" sets leaked haldi water. This was the only one that stayed sealed upside-down for 10 minutes, and the lids still clip tight after 20 open-close cycles.

## When to skip it

If you store only dry pulses in original packets, you don't need clip-locks — simpler canisters cost half as much.
